tasks.label: Serve player (harness)
tasks.detail: Static server on port 8099. Player page at /app/index.html, probe harness at /test/probes/harness/.

tasks.label: Build library
tasks.detail: esbuild: ESM, IIFE, and minified standalone bundles into dist/.

tasks.label: Run unit tests
tasks.detail: Jest. 12 suites, no browser or network needed.

tasks.label: Run E2E tests
tasks.detail: Playwright against a real browser. Start 'Serve player (harness)' first, or set MARP_PLAYER_TEST_URL.

tasks.label: Install Playwright browsers
tasks.detail: One-time setup before E2E tests can run.

tasks.label: Build library and serve
tasks.detail: Rebuild the bundles, then start the server. Use this after changing src/.
